label: D1 after a rare-rewarded a2 trial (a2 -> S1, rewarded), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), and only when the reward input is 1. About 91% of activation mass comes from D1 steps where the previous trial was a2 with a rare transition to S1 and was rewarded, which is exactly the rare-rewarded case where a model-based agent should switch away from a2. Every input it needs has been observed by D1. The feature is also gated by episode time: it never fires before trial ~60, and its rate peaks at trials 80-89. Without the time condition precision is 0.17 (F1 0.28). Adding ep_trial in 72..96 raises dev precision to 0.58, recall to 0.89 and F1 to 0.70. A low-value condition (value < 6.5) works about as well as the time window, so the late-episode gating may be carried by the falling value estimate of the model. Most remaining misses (about 9% of mass) are rewarded D1 steps on the first trial of the window, where prev_action is unknown in the window. It does not fire after a1 trials, common transitions, or unrewarded trials. Within the predicate, which steps fire and how strongly is not fully captured by these variables. Magnitude: max 0.43, median 0.18; I did not check what drives magnitude beyond the episode-time effect.
